download.description: Everyone has their own way of working, their own habits, and their favorite tools. We want Multiwheel to become a natural part of your workspace, helping you focus on what you love doing without getting distracted by the little things.

systems.question: Which operating systems will Multiwheel run on?
systems.answer: Multiwheel is being developed for Windows. Exact system requirements will be shared closer to release.

customization.question: Can I customize the wheel?
customization.answer: Personalizing the wheel and its actions is one of the core ideas behind Multiwheel.

applications.question: Which apps are supported?
applications.answer: The environments on this site illustrate the concept of contextual profiles. The final list of apps has not yet been confirmed.

release.question: When will Multiwheel be available to download?
release.answer: The app is currently in development.

context.workspaceLabel: Conceptual {{app}} workspace with an interactive Multiwheel demo

howItWorks.simpleHint: Tap a step to preview the sequence.
howItWorks.keyboardHint: Use Up, Down, Page Up, Page Down or Space for the previous and next step. Tab selects a step button. Escape leaves the scene.

philosophy.descriptionLineOne: Stop searching for the right tools.

home.description: A contextual radial menu for Windows. Open it with a hotkey to quickly access actions for the currently active application.

hero.description: The right tools, at the right moment. A radial menu that adapts to your workflow.

wheel.description: Choose a sector to preview an illustrative action. This demo does not execute commands or describe confirmed app features.
wheel.caption: Demo · Illustrative actions
wheel.hint: Hover, tap, or use the arrow keys
wheel.keyboardHint: Tab to enter or leave the wheel. Arrow keys move between sectors. Home and End move to the first and last sector. Enter or Space previews an action. Escape clears the selection. Pressing outside the wheel also clears the selection.
